note: DESIGN FIXTURE, NOT LISTINGS. Every entry here is invented, which is why the sample flag is set and why calendar.html refuses to load this file unless the URL explicitly asks for it (calendar.html?preview=sample) and then prints a banner on every screen. Titles are deliberately generic descriptions of event types rather than named readers: no real person is described as appearing anywhere. Links go to venue homepages, not to invented event pages. These dates go stale — that is fine, the file exists to exercise layout, not to be right.

events.title: Two poets, thirty minutes each
events.accessibility: Sanctuary is up one flight; no lift
events.description: Two readers, questions after, wine in the back. The Monday night shape this room has kept for decades.

events.title: Open mic, sign-up at 6:30
events.description: Twenty slots, three minutes each, first come. Arrive early if you want one.

events.title: Generative workshop: four Tuesdays
events.description: Four sessions, new work each week, no critique of anything unfinished. Sliding scale, nobody turned away.

events.title: Debut collection launch
events.description: Short reading, conversation, signing. Books available at the register.

events.title: Craft talk: revision as demolition
events.accessibility: Step-free entrance and lift to all floors
events.description: On throwing out the good lines. Bring a draft you are stuck on.

events.title: Prose night, three readers

events.title: Friday night slam

events.title: Signing and short reading
events.description: Rare Book Room, third floor. Ticket price includes the book.

events.title: Chapbook exchange and reading

events.title: Translation panel, four languages
events.description: Four translators on the lines they could not carry over.
